description: Project-level character and voice identity selection policy (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task B/C). One versioned record per project (plus per-job overrides). Explicit selections and exclusions always override automatic inference; NEW_ONLY disables registered identity selection entirely; a character cannot be both included and excluded; conflicting declarations are rejected by the runtime. Additive extension: project.json links to a policy by identity_policy_id; older v2.3 project records without one remain valid.

allow_new_task_local_characters.description: Whether new task-local character proposals are allowed. True in MIXED_REGISTERED_AND_NEW and NEW_ONLY; false in SELECTED_REGISTERED_ONLY unless the user explicitly allows it.

approval_status.description: Whether this policy is approved for production use.

excluded_character_ids.description: Registered character ids explicitly excluded. Exclusions always override automatic inference and selection.

is_project_default.description: True when this policy is the project's default identity policy.

mode.description: SELECTED_REGISTERED_ONLY: only the listed registered identities. MIXED_REGISTERED_AND_NEW: listed registered identities plus new task-local proposals. NEW_ONLY: no registered identity or voice at all. AUTO_MATCH_APPROVED: resolve unambiguous approved identities from the authorized registry scope.

per_job_override.description: True when this record overrides the project default for exactly one job. A job override never changes the project default.

provenance_note.description: One line saying why this provenance label applies.

registry_snapshot_version.description: Opaque version label of the registry snapshot this policy was resolved against (for example a record-hash prefix).

selected_character_ids.description: Registered character ids explicitly selected for this project/job. Empty in NEW_ONLY and (usually) in AUTO_MATCH_APPROVED.

voice_selection_policy.description: How voice profiles are selected for this project/job.

title: IdentitySelectionPolicy
